title: UseLayouts
brief: Premium animated React components and micro-interactions (Framer Motion + Tailwind) — one of the libraries in the shared UI-libraries list; Bencho and HyperUIX from the same list were already published.
details: useLayouts is a free library of animated React components built with Framer Motion (Motion) and Tailwind CSS. It covers 12+ layouts (grids, bento, hero sections), 14+ navigation patterns (navbars, tabs, sidebars), 18+ interactions (hover, drag, press, reveal), and 20+ UI pieces (cards, forms, galleries, pricing), each with purposeful motion, clean editable source, and a copy-customize-ship workflow that plays nicely with Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn, Radix, and Lucide. Praised by shadcn ecosystem builders like the founders of shadcnblocks and htmlrev, and maintained by 0xUrvish with a sponsor link. Free and open source.
